comment: dogmove.c dog_eat() 265, 297-299 and 335-340: in Kopasker's general store on Dlvl 3 (seed from a bounded 7302101-7302400 scan for a ^V arrival in a shop), a debug Samurai picks up an unpaid chain mail, creates a tame rust monster beside him and throws the mail at it. Iron armor is DOGFOOD for a rust monster and, unlike a weapon, reaches the tamedog() catch in thitmonst(), so the pet catches and eats it and the hero hears 'That chain mail will cost you 113 zorkmids.' The rustproof branch 302-311 needs the rust monster hungry (ACCFOOD) and is not covered here.
